programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: Highlights & Featured Content
programme.desc: Highlights of previous meetings and conferences, alongside pre-recorded curated videos from UN agencies showcasing the work of the UN in the field.

programme.title: Press Conference: Faiths for Oceans at COP17, UN Convention on Biodiversity
programme.desc: Faiths for Oceans will set out the key areas we are monitoring at CBD COP17: marine and coastal protection under 30x30, sustainable fisheries, finance that reaches coastal communities, and the rights and participation of Indigenous Peoples, local communities and faith actors. Speakers will share how faith communities are already caring for the ocean through sacred stewardship, from our work at UNOC3 and in Mombasa to the Faiths High Ambition Coalition for Ocean and Nature Action. The press conference will close with a first look at The Moral Catch, a new report on moral responsibility in fisheries, ahead of its launch at the Ocean Pavilion on Thursday 22 October.

programme.title: Working Group I (2nd meeting), UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The 17th meeting of the Conference of the Parties (COP 17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) will take place in October 2026. It will be held in conjunction with the twelfth meeting of the Parties to the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety (CP-MOP-12) and the sixth meeting of the Parties to the Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing (NP-MOP-6). COP 17 will mark the first global review of collective progress towards the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF).

programme.title: Press Conference: Women's Demands and Priorities, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: As COP17 opens in Yerevan, Armenia, the CBD Women's Caucus, with more than 900 members from around the world and diverse backgrounds, will set out its priorities and recommendations. COP17 must resolve a dense backlog of bracketed gender- and rights-based language across its agenda, including the global review of collective progress and the monitoring framework, resource mobilisation and the financial mechanism, the strategic review of the Programme of Work on Protected Areas, sustainable wildlife management and marine and coastal biodiversity, and the Nagoya Protocol. This COP represents a pivotal moment for women around the world, as the mid-term review of the Gender Plan of Action (2023-2030) will be adopted, and the decisions taken in Yerevan will shape whether gender justice is embedded in biodiversity governance for years to come. Across the agenda, the Caucus will reiterate its call for concrete, accountable and gender-transformative decisions, and for women, Indigenous Peoples and local communities, and youth to remain explicitly named and recognised as rights holders. The CBD Women's Caucus will also introduce its full engagement for the two weeks ahead, including key events, as this COP is not only a technical negotiation; it is a political moment that will shape the legacy of the Framework, and only gender-transformative decisions can deliver the fair, just, equitable, and sustainable future it envisions.

programme.title: Press Conference: Who Has a Voice in Biodiversity Decisions? Indigenous Peoples and local communities call for full and effective participation in the Subsidiary Body on Article 8(j), UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The International Indigenous Forum on Biodiversity (IIFB) will hold a press conference to highlight the importance of ensuring the full and effective participation of Indigenous Peoples and local communities in the work of the Subsidiary Body on Article 8(j) under the Convention on Biological Diversity. IIFB representatives will share their priorities and expectations for the modus operandi (working arrangements) of the Subsidiary Body, including how these arrangements can enable meaningful participation in its discussions and decision-making processes. As IIFB marks 30 years of engagement in the Convention, the press conference will also highlight the significance of this development for Indigenous Peoples and local communities and the importance of translating longstanding commitments on participation into practice.

programme.title: Press Conference: Halfway to 2030: Time to close the gaps and move from commitments to action, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: Greenpeace International highlights the key areas governments must act on to move from commitments to implementation and prevent irreversible ecosystem collapse and biodiversity loss. At COP17, leaders must address gaps in the implementation of the KM-GBF with concrete action; close the biodiversity finance gap; ensure quality of 30x30, from forests to the high seas, by safeguarding ecosystem integrity and respecting rights; and maximise synergies between climate and biodiversity action.

programme.title: Press Conference: Rising to the Freshwater Challenge: Armenia and Ethiopia join the world's largest freshwater restoration and protection initiative, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: Armenia (COP17 Presidency) and Ethiopia (Climate COP32 Presidency) joining the Freshwater Challenge - country-led initiative that is the world's largest freshwater restoration and protection initiative. These two countries will take membership to 56 and the EU. Other countries could also sign up in time to announce their membership during the press conference. The press conference will also announce progress under the Freshwater Challenge, including countries setting ambitious targets (Brazil, South Africa) and GEF funds for river restoration in three countries (Brazil, Cambodia, Tanzania) The press conference will precede an Official COP17 Side Event on scaling up the Freshwater Challenge

programme.title: Press Conference: The Essential Stewardship of Small-Scale Fishers: Communities' Contributions to the Effective Implementation of KMGBF, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: As the global community rallies to review the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KM GBF), small-scale fishers' organizations and communities are building on their long history and successes in the protection and sustainable use of their marine and inland fisheries resources. This 30-minute press briefing will showcase emblematic contributions and challenges, demonstrating how an explicit human rights-based approach (HRBA) accelerates and guarantees the effective implementation of KMGBF Targets – specifically Targets 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 14, 19, 20, 21, 22, and 23. This press conference builds on the experiences and struggles of Indigenous Peoples, local and Afrodescent small-scale fishing communities, bringing together efforts at the territorial level to defend their ways of life, cultural heritage, environmental and social resilience. The SSF delegation press brief will: Present evidence of the continuous active and knowledgeable participation of small-scale fishing communities in resource management and biodiversity protection in their marine territories of life.. Share emblematic examples of how a human rights-based approach provides a powerful catalyst for achieving global biodiversity milestones. Provide a direct platform for rights-holders, particularly fisherwomen and youth, to share their effective locally-led conservation strategies and challenges with the global press.

programme.title: Press Conference: Biodiversity Offsets and Credits: Who Benefits, Who Bears the Costs?, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: As negotiations at CBD COP17 unfold, this press conference will examine what the emerging outcomes on the so-called innovative schemes, including biodiversity offsets and credits, mean for Indigenous peoples, local communities, women and youth, as well as for efforts to address the root causes of biodiversity and forest loss. Civil society organizations and academic experts have raised serious concerns about the risks of biodiversity markets, including questions about their integrity and effectiveness in addressing the root causes of biodiversity loss and upholding human rights. Speakers will share evidence and perspectives on the implications of promoting, developing and using biodiversity offsets and credits as tools to mobilize biodiversity finance, and contrast these approaches with real solutions centered on rights-based, gender-responsive and Indigenous-led approaches. They will highlight practical alternatives for mobilising finance in ways that are equitable, effective and capable of driving transformative change. The press conference will also provide an opportunity to discuss and respond to developments in the COP17 negotiations, including their implications for equity, rights and the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.

programme.title: Press Conference: Why COP17 Must Uphold Rights-Based Biodiversity Commitments, UN Convention on Biodiversity
programme.desc: Indigenous Peoples, Afro-descendant Peoples, local communities, and civil society leaders will present a joint call to CBD Parties to uphold commitments to rights, safeguards, and direct access to finance at COP17. Speakers will highlight provisions currently under negotiation that could weaken recognition of Indigenous and Traditional Territories as a conservation pathway; free, prior and informed consent; direct financing through the Cali Fund; women's rights; and recognition of Afro-Descendant Peoples. The press conference will coincide with the delivery of a global open letter endorsed by organizations from around the world and will outline key priorities for ensuring COP17 advances, rather than weakens, implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.

programme.title: Press Conference: Parliamentary Report Launch: Delivering 30X30: Strengthening Biodiversity Conservation in the UK Overseas Territories, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The All Party Parliamentary Group on International Conservation, a cross party group of UK parliamentarians committed to protecting global biodiversity, has completed a report examining the role of the UK Overseas Territories (UKOTs) in the UK's ability to meet its 30x30 commitments. The Report has found that the UKOTs play an indispensable role for UK biodiversity but also global ecosystems. Because of the unique constitutional nature of the UKOTs, these critical habitats are often unable to access international support to their work. The Report therefore calls on long term, consistent support from the UK Government towards the UKOTs, not only to meet its requirements under 30x30 but to preserve key areas of biodiversity that are of global importance.

programme.title: Press Conference: We need to talk about the elephants in the room (and why ignoring them perpetuates biodiversity destruction), UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: Why does biodiversity keep being destroyed despite global efforts to protect it? The new report 'We need to talk about the elephants in the room' argues that the crisis cannot be solved by closing the finance gap alone, but needs to address the real drivers at play. The report analyses what's missing from the global review – the elephants in the room which are the root causes of biodiversity destruction: / The financial trap: rules that force countries to dig, drill and clear to stay solvent / The money problem: far more finance destroys nature than protects it / The corporate veto: companies can sue governments for protecting nature / The false fix: markets and offsets that let destruction continue Based on concrete cases from around the world, the authors of the report will explore the impacts of the biodiversity crisis and why the GBF can not succeed without addressing these drivers.

programme.title: Press Conference: Animals for Biodiversity and Health: Launch of new guidance to support national implementation of the Global Action Plan on Biodiversity and Health, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: At CBD COP17, the World Federation for Animals will launch new practical policy guidance to support national implementation of the Global Action Plan (GAP) on Biodiversity and Health adopted under CBD decision 16/19. The guidance translates global commitments and actions from the Plan into a menu of practical policy options that governments can adapt to their national circumstances, including through national biodiversity strategies and action plans, One Health frameworks and relevant wildlife, agriculture, climate and health policies. The guidance addresses wildlife protection and sustainable management, biodiversity–climate interlinkages, agricultural biodiversity and farm animal welfare. It demonstrates how animal health and welfare can strengthen biodiversity conservation, public health, resilient food systems and implementation of the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. The guidance has been developed in consultation with technical reviewers involving University of College London, the World Organization for Animal Health, the Landscape Alliance (CIFOR-ICRAF), and selected Parties. The press conference will introduce the guidance, highlight perspectives from government and technical partners, and invite countries to consider relevant policy measures for integration into national biodiversity strategies and action plans, One Health frameworks, national development plans and other relevant sectoral policies and planning processes.

programme.title: Press Conference: Breaking Barriers, Returning Conservation to the Hands of the Communities, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: Drawing on various issues and perspectives, including the Indonesian Peoples' Conservation Declaration adopted at the Peoples' Conservation Summit in early September, the Secretariat of the Working Group ICCAs Indonesia plans to utilize the summit's outcomes as a foundation for advocacy and negotiation at the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17 CBD) in 2026. This biennial conference will serve as a focal point for collective advocacy centered on the decolonization of conservation. This is an effort to dismantle the colonial paradigm wherein environmental protection frequently creates new mechanisms of exclusion against communities and their deeply rooted value systems, beliefs, and knowledge. These core ideas frame the urgency outlined in the Indonesian Peoples' Conservation Declaration, titled 'Restoring the Earth, Upholding Justice: Returning Conservation to the Hands of the Communities.' The key aspects addressed include: first, the practice of fortress conservation, a model of nature protection that divorces human living spaces from the natural environment, reduces forests to mere standing timber commodities, and operates on the assumption that nature is an empty space or terra nullius. Second, the commodification and financialization of nature, which treats biodiversity and natural resources as mere financial assets or investments intended to benefit a select few. Third, epistemic decolonization, which demands that scientific, indigenous, and spiritual knowledge be recognized equally. Finally, meaningful recognition, emphasizing that the acknowledgment of the territories of Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities (IPLCs) must be fundamentally coupled with full political and legal authority. Therefore, this press conference is designed to advance commitment from the national government while simultaneously reinforcing an advocacy and negotiation agenda rooted in the imperative of human rights-based conservation.

programme.title: Press Conference: Report Launch: Regulating Finance for Biodiversity: An Assessment for the Global Biodiversity Framework, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The Forests and Finance Coalition will be launching a major new report during the COP17 and would love the opportunity to introduce it to reporters via a panel of representatives from the groups who authored the research. The report, Regulating Finance for Biodiversity: An Assessment for the Global Biodiversity Framework, examines financial regulation in 11 jurisdictions that play major roles in financing forest-risk industries: Brazil, Canada, the Central African Economic and Monetary Community, China, the European Union, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the United States.

programme.title: Press Conference: Close the Justice Gap: Youth Demands for Transformative and Equitable Biodiversity Implementation, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The Global Youth Biodiversity Network (GYBN), bringing diverse youth voices from around the world to the international policy arena, will present the key calls from youth as the world takes on the first Global Review of collective progress in implementing the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. They will share their assessment of current global progress, their recommendations for the COP17 negotiations, and the pathway forward for genuine transformative change on the ground.

programme.title: Press Conference: Key reports launched to support the monitoring framework of the KMGBF, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The Initiative will be announcing and going into detail on the new State of Nature Indicators and Metrics Framework (launch: 13 October) and the CBD paper 'Alignment of the State of Nature Metrics with the monitoring framework of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework'

programme.title: Press Conference: Will Nature Markets and monetizing charismatic species bridge the biodiversity financing gap?, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The Global Mechanism for Biodiversity Finance (GMBF) sets the goal of achieving sufficient financial resources to close the US$700 billion annual biodiversity 'financing gap' as one of its targets for 2050. Nature Bonds and monetizing migratory megafauna and charismatic species for nature markets are being hailed as key to bridging this financing gap. The hope is that putting a price on nature will save nature. Speakers include Indigenous Peoples who have ancestral relationships with the species slated or already used for nature markets and will share their evaluations of whether credits, nature bonds and other financial instruments are the way to bridge the financing gap and how they may affect traditional knowledge systems recognized in Article 8(j) of the Convention. Speakers also include civil society experts who have documented case studies on the impacts on environmental integrity and communities of projects with megafauna and charismatic species for nature markets. Evidence will be presented on whether these financial mechanisms address the root causes of biodiversity loss and generate the much-needed funding. Coming towards the conclusion of the first week of COP17, the press conference will also provide an opportunity to evaluate the COP17 negotiations as they bear on the financialization of nature and traditional knowledge systems.

programme.title: Press Conference: A Global Prescription for Health: New International Alliance Launches at COP17 to Integrate Nature into Healthcare, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: As the world gathers at COP17 to advance action on nature and biodiversity protection, a new international alliance of health and conservation leaders is launching today to put nature at the heart of healthcare. Created to meet demand from health professionals and organizations around the world for a convenor and accelerator of the nature prescribing movement, the International Nature Prescribing Alliance (INPA) is a physician-led organization with world-leading expertise in health, nature and biodiversity, social prescribing and sustainable healthcare. Through network building, curated resources and expert-led events, INPA aims to advance community and planetary health — one prescription at a time. Some of INPA's partners include The Wildlife Trusts (UK), NatureScot, Dutch Nature-Inclusive Collective, Italian Academy of Biophilia, Italian Society of Environmental Medicine, Park Rx America, PaRx, People and Parks Foundation (Australia), National University of Singapore Centre for Sustainable Medicine, Planetary Health Alliance, and Healthcare Without Harm. The new Alliance builds on the success of Canada's nature prescription program, PaRx, an initiative of BC Parks Foundation that has mobilized over 22,000 regulated health professionals to issue over 2 million prescriptions for nature to people across Canada. Endorsed by over 100 major health organizations, including the Canadian Medical Association, and recognized by the World Health Organization, PaRx has put Canada on the map as a global leader in nature prescribing. INPA is proud to be hosted by another leading charity in Canada, the Canadian Coalition for Green Health Care, Canada's premier network dedicated to advancing environmentally sustainable health care. Research indicates that nature prescribing is an effective way to improve mental and physical health, decreasing disease burden and the associated ecological footprint of the healthcare sector. It also shows that people across the lifespan engage in more pro-environmental behaviours when they are more connected to nature. Therefore, expanding nature prescribing globally — and at the same time, increasing urban greening and biodiversity conservation to improve nature access — is a uniquely powerful way to simultaneously improve community health, reduce healthcare system emissions, waste and pollution, and shift values in favour of nature conservation and sustainability. Every nature prescription has the potential to restore our connection to the land, build planetary health values and action, and improve our wellbeing.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw – animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight. Winning these battles will make the difference between life and death, and with the stakes so high don't be surprised if the biggest animals don't have everything their own way. Welcome to nature's fight club.

programme.title: Pythons and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: For those of us that long to escape the rat race the pull of the wild can be strong. Whether we're risking our lives with extreme sports, following our animal passions or just taking a walk on the wild side, the natural world calls to us. What's more, the power of nature tests our limits, opens our eyes and heals our hearts in equal measure. So why try to resist such a beautiful, exciting and enlightening siren song? Perhaps there's nothing better for us humans than to follow the pull of the wild.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: The second episode takes you on an underwater adventure to the remote and beautiful islands of Fiji, where people face the formidable predators of the ocean. Through stunning underwater world teeming with life and intimate interviews with passionate shark feeders we will capture the raw power and beauty of these incredible creatures. We will also shed light on the importance of shark conservation and the urgent need to protect these apex predators from human threats.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats
programme.desc: The Gosa Gang have recently moved to a new home known as Fortress burrow. It is close to the Gosa Dam where a rival family of meerkats live.In the quest for territorial dominance there has been a major meerkat standoff. This has resulted in both gangs losing a member of their tribe.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats
programme.desc: Recently Priscilla bought an adopted boy pup from a rival gang to the Gosa Burrow. Unfortunately his acceptance into the Gosa group was far from ideal. His life did not get any easier after this

programme.title: Tundra
programme.desc: What at first it can seem an icy wasteland, the tundra is actually a tapestry of interconnected life creatures relying on one another to survive the long winter.
